title_zh: 笑容的拓扑学：牙科成像中的持续同调
title_en: Topology of a Smile: Persistent Homology in Dental Imaging
summary_zh: CBCT（锥形束计算机断层扫描）提供了详细的三维牙科影像，广泛用于诊断和治疗规划。本文提出利用拓扑数据分析中的持续同调方法，结合支持向量机，实现CBCT扫描中牙齿的分类和诊断自动化。该方法在牙齿标注和诊断任务中分别达到97.67%和96.77%的平均准确率，显著优于同数据上的卷积神经网络（分别为70.27%和86.67%）。
summary_en: CBCT (Cone Beam Computed Tomography) scans offer detailed 3D dental images widely used for diagnosis and treatment planning. This paper proposes using persistent homology, a topological data analysis framework, combined with a support vector machine to automate tooth classification and diagnostics in CBCT scans. The method achieves average accuracies of 97.67% for tooth labeling and 96.77% for diagnostics, outperforming a CNN trained on the same data (70.27% and 86.67%, respectively).

title_zh: EditStream：用于交互式视频生成与编辑的统一自回归框架
title_en: EditStream: A Unified Autoregressive Framework for Interactive Video Generation and Editing
summary_zh: EditStream 是一个统一的交互式视频生成与编辑框架，基于 DiT 模型通过灵活的任务特定条件实现多种视频创建与操作任务的整合。它支持文本到视频、图像到视频、视频到视频、编辑传播、参考引导视频编辑和摄像机位姿变化等多种功能，提供了对视频生成、转换和编辑的灵活控制。为了适应互动使用，提出了一种结合速度矩匹配（VMM）与自回归展开的两阶段蒸馏方法，有效提升生成质量和时间稳定性，解决了过度饱和、运动退化和复杂训练等挑战。该方法为高质量扩散视频模型与创意交互工作流之间架起了实用且可扩展的桥梁。
summary_en: EditStream is a unified framework for interactive video generation and editing that integrates multiple video creation and manipulation tasks within a single DiT-based model via flexible task-specific conditioning. It supports Text-to-Video, Image-to-Video, Video-to-Video, Editing Propagation, Reference-guided Video Editing, and Camera Pose Change, enabling flexible control over video generation, transformation, and editing. To make the model practical for interactive use, a two-stage distillation approach combining Velocity Moment Matching (VMM) with autoregressive unrolling is developed, improving generation quality, motion preservation, and temporal stability while mitigating common challenges like over-saturation and complex training. EditStream offers a practical and scalable solution bridging high-quality diffusion-based video models with interactive creative workflows.

title_zh: KVBoost：基于偏差引导重计算的块级键值缓存复用，实现大语言模型高效推理
title_en: KVBoost: Chunk-Level Key-Value Cache Reuse with Deviation-Guided Recomputation for Efficient Large Language Model Inference
summary_zh: KVBoost提出了一种适用于HuggingFace解码器模型的块级键值缓存复用系统，解决了传统前缀缓存只能针对连续前缀的限制。该系统引入双哈希键方案，支持内容位置无关的精确及近似缓存匹配，并通过选择性重计算和缓存融合重计算修复关注边界错误。结合不对称KV量化、自适应块边界分割和重要性驱动的缓存淘汰，KVBoost在Qwen/Qwen2.5-3B模型上实现了4.49倍的首令牌时间缩短且准确率无损。该方案为RoPE-based模型提供了兼容性且实用的内存受限推理加速方法，无需改动模型架构。
summary_en: KVBoost introduces a chunk-level key-value cache reuse system compatible with HuggingFace decoder models to overcome limitations of existing prefix caching that requires contiguous prefixes. It features a dual-hash keying scheme for position-independent exact and approximate cache matches, and employs selective recomputation and cache blending to fix attention boundary errors. Incorporating asymmetric KV quantization, adaptive chunk splitting, and importance-weighted eviction, KVBoost achieves a 4.49x reduction in time-to-first-token on Qwen/Qwen2.5-3B with no accuracy loss. This provides a practical memory-bounded acceleration layer compatible with RoPE-based models without architectural changes.
why_it_matters_zh: 此论文提出了创新的缓存复用与重计算方法，显著降低大语言模型推理延迟，提升实际部署效率，且兼容现有模型架构，属于前沿推理优化研究。
why_it_matters_en: The paper presents innovative cache reuse and recomputation strategies that significantly reduce inference latency for large language models, improving practical deployment efficiency while maintaining architectural compatibility, making it a leading-edge research contribution in inference optimization.

title_zh: AIREP：用于人工智能运行时治理的逐决策证据协议
title_en: AIREP: A Protocol for Per-Decision Evidence in AI Runtime Governance
summary_zh: 本文提出了一种协议，用于记录自动化AI运行时的治理决策。该协议对每一次运行时的输出行为（如释放、阻止、延迟、编辑或升级）生成一个单独签名的决策记录，任何第三方均可离线验证。记录中包含封闭类别的动词、基于策略的依据，使用哈希索引输入、输出和证据，且声明证据的涵盖与排除。记录通过SHA-256哈希链绑定位置，确保防篡改和缺失检测。格式中供应商、模型和领域相关内容被限制在独立命名空间内，并通过机械中立性测试保持共享格式的中立性。文中还介绍了参考实现和双语言合规测试套件，探讨了实施细节及挑战，旨在被任何AI运行时采纳以记录治理决策。
summary_en: This paper presents a protocol for recording governance decisions made by automated AI runtimes. Each output action (release, block, defer, redact, escalate) is recorded as a single signed object verifiable offline by any party. The record uses a closed set of verbs under stated policy, references input, output, and evidence by hash, and declares coverage scope. Records are linked in a SHA-256 hash chain to ensure tamper and gap detection. Vendor-, model-, and domain-specific content is isolated in an optional namespace, and a mechanical neutrality test ensures format neutrality. A reference implementation and bilingual conformance kit are provided; implementation issues are discussed. The protocol is proposed for adoption by AI runtimes to transparently record governance decisions.
why_it_matters_zh: 该研究为AI系统治理提供了一种透明且可验证的记录机制，有助于提升AI输出决策的可审计性和信任度，是AI治理领域的重要技术进展。
why_it_matters_en: This research offers a transparent, verifiable mechanism to record AI runtime governance decisions, enhancing auditability and trust in AI outputs. It represents a significant advancement in AI governance technologies.

title_zh: 证据状态可靠性在受控降级下的表现：多阶段大语言模型管道中的解析器有效性偏离
title_en: Evidence-State Reliability Under Controlled Degradation: Parser-Validity Divergence in a Multi-Stage LLM Pipeline
summary_zh: 本文提出了证据状态可靠性（ESR）评估层，用于衡量多阶段大语言模型管道中中间证据的完整性、依据性、一致性和可用性，独立于结构解析有效性。通过在GLM-5.2模型上，对清洁、压缩损失、部分丢失和噪声冲突四种证据条件下的决策、审计和升级阶段进行720次调用，发现结构有效性可能提升，而基于证据的阶段成功率下降，揭示了结构一致性与证据敏感性的可靠性偏离。研究还区分了证据降级的检测和恢复。结论受限于所评估的模型配置和测试设计。
summary_en: This paper introduces Evidence-State Reliability (ESR), an evaluation layer measuring whether intermediate evidence in multi-stage LLM pipelines remains complete, grounded, internally consistent, and usable, distinct from parser validity which measures structural conformance. Using GLM-5.2 across 60 sanitized base cases and four evidence degradation conditions (clean, compressed-lossy, partial-dropout, noisy-conflicting) processed through decision, audit, and escalation stages, the study finds that parser validity can improve while evidence-sensitive stage success deteriorates, indicating a bounded divergence in reliability layers. It also differentiates between detection of degraded evidence and recovery. Conclusions are limited to the evaluated pipeline design and conditions.
why_it_matters_zh: 该论文基于实证实验，提出并验证了一个新的评估层ESR，拓展了多阶段LLM管道中结构有效性之外的可靠性评估维度，揭示了结构合规性和基于证据的功能成功之间可能存在的偏离，具备较高的研究价值和应用指导意义。
why_it_matters_en: The paper offers a concrete, empirical study of a novel evaluation concept—Evidence-State Reliability—relevant to assessing multi-stage LLM pipeline robustness beyond structural parser validity. It reveals meaningful divergences between structural conformance and evidence-sensitive task success under controlled degradation, advancing understanding of LLM pipeline reliability and evaluation.
